title: Configuration baseline
statement: The project shall identify concept variant, source hash, geometry, mass and CG baseline for each accepted load case.
acceptance: Every model and run resolves to the same approved variant, source and load baseline.

title: Land mobility
statement: Each variant shall demonstrate operator-controlled steering, traction and braking within its approved land envelope.
acceptance: Stopping distance, grade and handling meet approved load/surface/speed criteria; values remain TBD.

title: Buoyancy and stability
statement: Each hull shall meet approved loaded freeboard, stability and defined flooded-condition criteria.
acceptance: Measured mass/CG and geometry satisfy approved heel, trim, reserve buoyancy and flooding criteria.

title: Marine propulsion
statement: Marine propulsion shall be enabled only within its validated immersion and actuator-availability envelope.
acceptance: Invalid, stale or contradictory immersion evidence invokes the approved inhibit/limit policy.

title: Mode transitions
statement: A local supervisor shall authorize LAND, TRANSITION and WATER using operator intent and validated guards.
acceptance: Allowed transitions are covered; ambiguous guards, timeout and bounded drive overlap follow the approved policy.

title: Energy and ingress
statement: The design shall define energy isolation, thermal limits, ingress monitoring and charge/service propulsion interlocks.
acceptance: Approved electrical/thermal/ingress profiles and charge/service inhibits pass; ratings and thresholds remain TBD.

title: Fault and timing policy
statement: The supervisor shall meet allocated execution deadlines and mode-specific hazard-derived fault-response times.
acceptance: Timing and fault traces meet the approved load profile and response budgets; no deadline claimed from tool choice.

title: Local authority
statement: Essential control and fault handling shall remain local during loss of engineering, cloud or telemetry connections.
acceptance: Local operation follows approved loss policy; remote analytics, UI and AI cannot publish actuator commands.

title: Coupled-model contract
statement: Land and water models shall share configuration, SI units, frames and a declared clock/solver owner for each coupled state.
acceptance: No duplicate state integration; handover, unit/frame and validity-domain checks meet approved error budgets.

title: Telemetry and evidence
statement: Test records shall preserve timestamps, validity, source versions, configuration and requirement/test references.
acceptance: Mandatory fields and approved rate/buffer profiles pass; stale/reordered data are flagged and no verdict lacks evidence.

title: Maintainability
statement: Each variant shall define service isolation, hull/drivetrain access, drainage and post-service integrity checks.
acceptance: Required service tasks and integrity checks are demonstrated against an approved procedure.

title: Stage release
statement: Each stage shall close critical design decisions and approve operating envelope, configuration and verification dispositions.
acceptance: No stage-critical TBD or failed criterion remains without an accepted disposition; no physical verification inferred from an image.

title: Roadster packaging
statement: The AM-S baseline shall define occupant/restraint space and enclosure/hull packaging from a dimensioned design.
acceptance: Occupancy, access, clearances and loaded geometry are approved; image appearances are not measurements.

title: Roadster drivetrain allocation
statement: AM-S shall document separate land/marine drive allocation and transition clearances for its selected configuration.
acceptance: Approved drive allocation and hull openings are traceable; retraction, hydrofoils and autonomy are not assumed.

title: Utility load cases
statement: AM-U6 shall define secured cargo and occupant load cases and their effect on mass, CG and waterline.
acceptance: Every approved cargo case satisfies restraint and stability criteria; payload capacity remains TBD.

title: Utility running gear
statement: AM-U6 shall define six-wheel steering, braking, traction and load-sharing for the selected running-gear proposal.
acceptance: Wheel/axle loads and control behavior satisfy approved land cases; wheel count is concept intent, dimensions remain TBD.

title: Motorcycle balance
statement: AM-B shall define rider posture, low-speed land balance and rider/vehicle stability through land-water transition.
acceptance: Rider-load and balance criteria are approved and verified for each relevant mode.

title: Motorcycle wet boundaries
statement: AM-B shall define rider exposure, immersion-sensitive components and service access for the selected hull/propulsor design.
acceptance: Wet-volume, isolation and service criteria pass for the approved configuration; image does not establish a rating.
